# NCLT returning-section geometry

`nclt-returning-section.json` contains 27 corresponding cross-sections from the
first 50 m piece of a CloudAnalyzer draft generated from the bundled April NCLT
demo. The reference is reconstructed as the midpoint of the first two boundaries;
it is not a surveyed lane centre or the original sensor trajectory. The boundaries
retain the draft's measured/inferred positions and heights.

Source: University of Michigan North Campus Long-Term (NCLT), 2012-04-29,
Carlevaris-Bianco, Ushani and Eustice, IJRR 2016.
The prepared source is `web/public/samples/nclt-2012-04-29.mcap`; see the repository's
sample attribution for the thinned 190-second excerpt and preparation scripts.
This derived database is offered under the [ODbL](https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/)
with contents under the [Database Contents License](https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/dbcl/1-0/).

The fixture reproduces ambiguous Lanelet2 boundary-direction inference. It is
workflow regression data, not a ground-truth map or evidence of survey accuracy.
